messages:
alice.m: Heads up — some traffic to the PL interface endpoints in us-west-2 is getting blackholed after the nat-gw rollout.
ben.t: seeing similar, s3 and kms interface endpoints from pods in prod-subnet-3 failing intermittently
alice.m: symptoms: DNS resolves to private ENI IP, TLS handshake times out. curl to https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com from a bastion works.
cody.s: can you paste output of `dig +short s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` from a pod?
alice.m: ```
$ dig +short s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
10.0.45.12
10.0.67.89
```
ben.t: we checked VPC endpoints: `aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-abc` all endpoints show state=available and subnet-ids include prod-subnet-3
cody.s: checked ENIs, status=available, SG attached is ep-sg (egress 0.0.0.0/0 tcp/443) — but pods are in a private cluster using nat-gw for internet egress
alice.m: trace shows pod -> node iptables SNAT to nat-gw EIP, but return packets to the ENI IP are routed to interface endpoint ENI which drops them because source IP is NATed EIP not pod private IP
ben.t: ahh — interface endpoints expect traffic from VPC private IPs not from public EIPs. NATted flow breaks destination check on the service side.
infra-bot: automated note: recent change 1825608000 applied: replace NAT instances with AWS NAT Gateways in az-b and az-c
cody.s: quick repro: `curl -v --resolve 's3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com:443:10.0.45.12' https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` -> TCP handshake stalls when source is NAT EIP
ben.t: workaround: add a VPC endpoint policy allowing traffic from EIPs? Not possible. Short term: route egress for services that hit PL endpoints via VPC NAT to not SNAT — need to preserve source IP. Options: 1) enable endpoint-specific route where nodes route to ENI directly, 2) move pods to subnets that don't egress through NAT GW, 3) use proxy in VPC that preserves source.
alice.m: decided: rollback nat-gw change for prod-subnet-3 and flip routing so node egress to PL endpoints doesn't go via NAT. Cody, can you run kube patch to annotate nodes to prefer local ENI for PL subnets?
cody.s: on it. patching kube-proxy iptables rules to add specific route for 10.0.0.0/16 -> eni-lookup
ben.t: created a temporary ip rule on nodes to preserve src: `ip rule add from 10.0.0.0/16 table 200; ip route add default via 10.0.45.1 dev eth0 table 200` — testing now
alice.m: after route tweak, handshakes succeed. monitoring for a few mins.
ben.t: rolling alert cleared :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: follow-up item: update runbook to include 'preserve source IP for PL endpoints' and add e2e test for nat-gw cutover. filing ticket INF-4921
alice.m: thanks everyone. we'll schedule a design to avoid this on next nat rollout. :pray:
